Cloudsmith raises $72 million to expand its artifact management platform

Cloudsmith raises a new funding round led by TCV, bringing total funding to more than one hundred million dollars. The company provides cloud-native artifact management and software supply chain security for enterprises around the world.

The company said the new capital will be used to expand its engineering team and to invest in its package repository platform, including support for more package formats and deeper security scanning of open source dependencies.

Customers use the platform to store, secure, and distribute software packages, container images, and machine learning models across their development and production environments, with policy controls and audit logging included.

Analysts say the market for artifact management is consolidating as buyers look for a single place to enforce software supply chain policy from the first commit through to production deployment of every release.
